summary: Complete frontend testing of Custom Block Elements feature in Shop Owner Dashboard. All features working correctly: block picker dialog, adding heading/video/url blocks, edit/delete/toggle/move functionality, and storefront rendering.

issues: 404 errors for some resources (non-critical, likely missing images)

passed_tests: Login with demo1@proid.vn / iLoveProID@ works
Navigation to Layout tab (data-testid='nav-layout') works
Block picker dialog opens when clicking 'Thêm khối tùy chỉnh' button (data-testid='add-custom-block-btn')
All 6 block types available: heading, rich_text, image, image_grid, video, url
Block type buttons have correct data-testid (block-type-heading, block-type-video, block-type-url, etc.)
Can add a Heading block with text, level (h1-h4), and alignment
Can add a Video block with YouTube URL - preview shows in edit dialog
Can add a URL/Link block with text and URL
Custom blocks appear in layout section list with purple 'Custom' badge
Custom blocks have edit (pencil) and delete (trash) buttons with data-testid
Custom blocks can be toggled on/off
Custom blocks can be moved up/down to reorder
Edit dialog opens when clicking edit button on custom block
Block edit dialog fields work: block-label-input, block-heading-text, block-video-url, block-url-input, block-url-text
Save button (data-testid='save-block-btn') saves custom block
Custom blocks render on storefront page (/shop/demo1) in correct order
Heading renders as h2 with correct text on storefront
Video block renders as embedded YouTube iframe on storefront
URL button block renders as clickable button with theme color on storefront
Toast notification 'Cửa hàng đã được cập nhật' shows after saving
critical_code_review_comments: Custom block implementation is complete with all 6 block types (heading, rich_text, image, image_grid, video, url)
Block picker dialog properly shows all block types with icons and descriptions
Block edit dialog dynamically shows fields based on block type
Layout sections correctly handle both built-in sections and custom blocks
Storefront renderSection function properly renders all custom block types
YouTube video embedding works with proper URL parsing
URL blocks support button, link, and banner styles
seed_data_creation: Created 3 test custom blocks during testing: Test Heading Block, Test Video Block, Test URL Block
context_for_next_testing_agent: Custom block feature fully implemented and tested.
